citations.claim: EW approach E is green at first violating step under emergency
NS was yellow one second earlier, so no all-red gap
NS started green, emergency forced immediate switch

explanation: Emergency preempt jumps directly from NS yellow (step1) to EW green (step2) with 0s all-red, skipping required 4s clearance and truncating yellow from 6s to 1s. Controller prioritizes emergency direction instantly without yellow/all-red timing.

violation.detail: approach 1 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 4 s)

vision_note: Steps 0 to 1 show one direction green then yellow, while the cross direction stays red. At step 2 the lights flip instantly so the cross direction is green and the first direction is red, with no all-red gap and only one second of yellow.
